usages.explain: Expresses the meaning of "to the best of one's ability, to the fullest extent possible." At the end of the sentence, phrases expressing intention, desire, reliance, etc. are often used.

examples.content: なるべくお客様に丁寧な言葉をお使い下さい。
examples.transcription: なるべくおきゃくさまにていねいなことばをおつかいください。
examples.mean: Please use polite language to your customers as much as possible.

examples.content: なるべく早く国へ帰りたい。
examples.transcription: なるべくはやくくにへかえりたい。
examples.mean: I want to return to my country as soon as possible.

title: なるべく => as much as possible
